title: Property Management Coordinator
description:
Job Summary We are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented, and organized Property Management Coordinator to support property managers and internal teams across the end-to-end tenant lifecycle. This role covers rental inquiries, application processing, lease preparation and renewals, work order management, tenant accounting, delinquency follow-ups, reporting, and general property management administration. The ideal candidate will take ownership of assigned tasks, maintain accurate documentation, coordinate effectively with tenants and internal teams, and ensure all activities are completed accurately and within established timelines. Key Responsibilities 1. Rental Applications and Tenant Screening Respond to rental inquiries and assist applicants throughout the application process. Review applications and verify required documents and information. Identify missing documents or discrepancies and follow up with applicants. Prepare applicant summaries for the property managers review. Track application progress and ensure timely follow-ups. 2. Lease Preparation and Renewals Prepare monthly and annual lease renewal proposals. Track upcoming lease expirations and initiate renewal processes. Prepare lease offers and related documents for approval. Coordinate with tenants and property managers to complete renewals. Maintain updated lease records and renewal trackers. 3. Tenant Move-In, Move-Out and Accounting Coordinate move-in and move-out documentation and inspection checklists. Prepare final tenant statements, including rent, payments, deposits, and applicable charges. Review account statements for accuracy. Assist with account reconciliation and resolve discrepancies. 4. Delinquency Follow-Ups and Account Management Review tenant accounts and identify overdue payments. Follow up with tenants regarding outstanding balances. Prepare balance-due letters and credit letters. Track pending payments and escalate unresolved issues. 5. Work Order Management Track work orders from submission to completion. Coordinate with tenants, vendors, and internal teams for updates. Follow up on pending maintenance requests. Escalate delayed or unresolved work orders. 6. Reporting and Documentation Prepare tenant reports, delinquency reports, and lease renewal trackers. Maintain accurate and organized tenant records and lease documents. Review reports and documents for accuracy. Track pending tasks, missing information, and important deadlines. 7. Property Manager and Team Support Provide daily administrative and operational support to property managers. Coordinate with leasing, accounting, and maintenance teams. Complete assigned tasks within established timelines and procedures. Provide regular updates and escalate issues when required. Support additional property management activities as needed. Qualifications and Skills Experience in residential property management, leasing, or real estate administration is preferred. Strong attention to detail and organizational skills. Ability to prepare clear, accurate, and professional documents. Good written and verbal communication skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and property management software. Ability to manage multiple tasks, meet deadlines, and follow established procedures. Strong follow-up, coordination, and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with property managers and internal teams. A proactive mindset with a strong sense of responsibility and task ownership. Role Details Title Property Management Coordinator Department Finance Employment Type Full-Time, Permanent Job Location Remote, New Delhi Industry KPO, Outsourcing/Offshoring Shift Time EST/PST - US Timezone Required Skills finance Communication Skills Advanced Excel

title: Senior Demand Planner Global Water Equipment
description:
Senior Demand Planner Global Water Equipment Pune, India | Global Equipment Supply Chain Planning LOCATION 
Pune, India SCOPE 
Global Nalco Water Equipment 
 KEY PARTNERS 
 Global Commercial Teams, Third-Party Contract Manufacturers, Regional Assembly Facilities Our Global Supply Chain is a network of more than 300 manufacturing plants, distribution centers and other facilities designed and located to support our direct sales, marketing and distribution activities. We enable company growth by delivering savings through more efficient operations and high levels of service that create competitive advantage while earning and keeping customers' trust. The Senior Demand Planner Global Water Equipment will join the Supply Chain Planning team and play an integral role in advancing demand forecasting and Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) processes for Nalco Water equipment worldwide. Based in Pune, India, this role will report into the North America Planning team while operating with a global scope. The planner will partner with commercial teams across regions, third-party contract manufacturers, and regional assembly facilities to create an aligned, accurate, and executable demand plan that supports customer service, capacity decisions, and business growth. 
 What's in It for You 
 Opportunity to influence a global equipment planning network and build relationships with commercial and supply chain leaders across multiple regions. High visibility to the North America Planning team and cross-functional stakeholders in Sales, Marketing, Finance, Operations, Procurement, and Manufacturing. Opportunity for a long-term career path with exposure to all areas of the company's global supply chain. Access to best-in-class resources, tools, and technology. Thrive in a company that values personal and professional development, sustainability, a safety-focused culture, and ethical business practices. 
 What You Will Do 
 Lead the global monthly product demand forecast cycle for Nalco Water equipment, integrating regional inputs into one aligned demand plan. Partner with commercial teams across North America, Latin America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia Pacific to incorporate current and long-term market intelligence at the product, customer, and market levels. Develop, document, challenge, and update the assumptions supporting regional and global demand plans, particularly when demand outlooks differ from business plans or historical trends. Collaborate with the North America Planning team to align planning standards, governance, calendars, metrics, and Executive S&OP requirements. Engage third-party contract manufacturers and regional assembly facilities to translate demand signals into actionable capacity, material, and production requirements. Identify demand and supply risks across contract manufacturing and regional assembly networks, escalate constraints, and support scenario planning and mitigation actions. Improve forecast accuracy by validating data inputs, leveraging the existing statistical forecasting application, and refining statistical forecasts with commercial and regional business input. Use exception management and root cause analysis to identify forecast deviations, demand volatility, data issues, and corrective actions with relevant stakeholders. Own demand plan performance, including forecast error, accuracy, and bias, by measuring actual versus planned volume at multiple planning levels and across regions. Prepare and present global and regional performance metrics, insights, risks, and recommendations to commercial, planning, and operations stakeholders to drive continuous improvement. Partner with Marketing and regional teams to incorporate new product introductions, product conversions, phase-ins, phase-outs, and product deactivations into the global plan. Support Executive S&OP processes and meetings by providing a consolidated demand perspective, key assumptions, regional variances, opportunities, and risks. Coordinate effectively across time zones and cultures to maintain a consistent global planning cadence and timely decision-making. Conduct additional business and supply chain analyses for equipment products as needed. 
 Minimum Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Engineering, Finance, Marketing, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in supply chain planning, demand planning, finance, marketing, manufacturing, or a related analytical discipline. Experience collaborating with commercial and supply chain teams across multiple countries, regions, or time zones. Significant experience with ERP systems, advanced planning systems, statistical forecasting applications, analytical tools, or equivalent software. High proficiency with Microsoft Office, especially Excel and Word. Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with regional and global audiences and to present complex information clearly. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to drive decisions and build consensus among cross-functional stakeholders. Ability to navigate complex policy, process, cultural, and people-related organizational dynamics. Track record of delivering against key performance indicators and business objectives. Demonstrated strategic mindset, ownership, and ability to work independently within a globally distributed team. Ability to accommodate periodic meetings outside standard local business hours to support global stakeholders. 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience in demand planning, manufacturing, or supply chain operations for engineered equipment or configured-to-order products. Experience working with third-party contract manufacturers and regional assembly or manufacturing facilities. Experience supporting global or regional S&OP / Integrated Business Planning processes. Experience with statistical forecasting applications and forecast performance management. Proficiency in SAP, particularly Materials Management (MM) and Production Planning (PP) modules. Experience in a matrixed, multinational organization.

Key Skills: Senior,Equipment,Demand forecasting,Global,Water,Planning,Forecasting,Business planning
